title: Grilled Pork Chops with Fresh Herbs
description: This grilled pork chops with fresh herbs recipe, marinated in lemon, soy sauce, parsley, rosemary, thyme, coriander, and garlic makes a tasty dinner.
ingredients: 4 tablespoons olive oil, or more to taste
4 (6 ounce) bone-in pork chops (1 inch thick)

steps.text: Whisk olive oil, soy sauce, lemon juice, parsley, rosemary, thyme, coriander, lemon zest, and garlic together in a shallow dish. Add pork chops; toss to evenly coat. Cover the dish with plastic wrap; marinate in the refrigerator, at least 1 hour, flipping halfway through.
Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat and lightly oil the grate.
Remove chops from marinade and shake off excess. Discard remaining marinade.

Place chops on the preheated grill; reduce grill temperature to medium. Cook chops until no longer pink in centers, about 8 minutes per side. An instant-read thermometer inserted into centers should read 145 degrees F (63 degrees C). Rest before serving, 5 minutes.
